# `@mediawiki-typescript/api` instructions

A typed axios-based client for the MediaWiki Action API (`api.php`) and REST API (`rest.php/v1`).
See `docs/plans/api/plan.md` for the full phased implementation plan, decisions, and progress checklist — **keep that doc up to date** as phases land.

## Package layout

- `src/client/MediaWikiClient.ts` — core class, one instance per wiki: axios instance bound to `{baseUrl}/w/api.php`, format=json&formatversion=2 defaults, maxlag retry, error normalization (`call()`), token caching (`getToken()`), capability detection (`getCapabilities()`).
- `src/client/MediaWikiClientRegistry.ts` — optional named-registry convenience wrapper: `register()`/`setWiki()`/`use()`/`current` for consumers that want a single mutable "current wiki" (e.g. mw-cli) instead of holding client instances themselves.
- `src/auth/` — pluggable `AuthStrategy` interface + `BotPasswordAuth` (clientlogin + cookie jar + CSRF) + `OAuthAuth` (OAuth 1.0a signing). New auth mechanisms implement the same interface.
- `src/versioning/` — `detectCapabilities()` (siteinfo-based version/extension detection) + `moduleRegistry.ts` (per-module version override table, populated incrementally as real incompatibilities are discovered — do not pre-populate speculative history).
- `src/content/` — the **content bridge** shared by both APIs: `resolveContentInput()` (accepts `string | MediaWikiContent | MediaWikiContent[]`, normalizes to wikitext via builder's `buildContents`) and `resolveContentOutput()` (shapes a response's wikitext per a caller-requested `ContentReturnFormat`: `"string"` raw wikitext, `"json"` raw untouched response, `"contents"` parsed via `@mediawiki-typescript/parser`'s `parse()`). Any new content-bearing module (read or write) must reuse these, not reimplement the branching.
- `src/action/generated/` — codegen output from `action=paraminfo` (typed request params for every Action API module, incl. all `query` prop/list/meta/generator submodules). Generated by `packages/api/codegen/`, run via `npm run codegen`; **not** regenerated at consumer install/build time. Commit generated output.
- `src/action/core/` — hand-authored precise response types + ergonomic wrappers for the curated high-value modules (query info/revisions/categories/links/images/extracts/langlinks, allpages/search/categorymembers/backlinks lists, generators, login/clientlogin, edit, upload, delete, move, parse, compare, opensearch, siteinfo, tokens), built on top of `generated/` param types.
- `src/rest/` — `RestApiClient` covering `/rest.php/v1` search/pages/transform/media-files/history endpoints, reusing `src/content/` for content-bearing endpoints and the same `AuthStrategy`/CSRF plumbing as the Action API client.
- `src/errors/` — `MediaWikiApiError` (normalizes both Action API `error`/`errors[]` and REST HTTP-problem-json failures) and `MediaWikiAuthError`.

## Conventions

- **Document everything.** This package is intentionally over-documented relative to the rest of the monorepo: every exported class, interface, type, method, and non-trivial parameter needs a JSDoc comment (not just the tricky bits) — this is a deliberate, explicit deviation from the "only comment what the code can't show" default, because this package's whole purpose is being a discoverable, typed surface for consumers who won't read the implementation.
- **Coverage boundary**: codegen gives 100% typed *request* coverage across all modules; response types are only precise for the curated `action/core` set, generic/passthrough elsewhere. Don't try to hand-model every module's response shape — that's an explicit, documented scope boundary (see plan doc "Further Considerations"), not an oversight.
- **One client instance = one wiki.** Never make `MediaWikiClient` a global singleton or give it mutable "current wiki" state directly — that's what `MediaWikiClientRegistry` is for.
- Any new module that sends or returns page content **must** go through `resolveContentInput`/`resolveContentOutput` rather than handling wikitext directly, so behavior stays identical across Action API and REST API call sites.
- `@mediawiki-typescript/builder` and `@mediawiki-typescript/parser` are consumed via their compiled `dist/` output — after changing either package, run `npm run build` there before testing changes here.
- Auth strategies must not assume cookie-based sessions: `requiresCsrfToken()` lets shared write-path code (edit, REST page create/update) decide whether to fetch+attach a CSRF token, since OAuth doesn't need one.

## Testing

- Unit tests use `nock` to mock HTTP (no live network calls in the default `npm test` run) — see `MediaWikiClient.test.ts` for the pattern (maxlag retry, error normalization, token caching).
- Content bridge tests (`resolveContentInput.test.ts`/`resolveContentOutput.test.ts`) exercise builder/parser directly with no network mocking needed.
- Opt-in integration tests against a public test wiki (e.g. test.wikipedia.org) are env-flag-gated and must never run by default in CI.
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx eslint src`, and `npx jest` in `packages/api` after any change, then the full root `npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test` (turbo) to confirm no cross-package regressions.

See `docs/plans/api/plan.md` for the complete phase breakdown, open decisions, and rationale.
